items.title: Can the US and China verify an AI deal? Start-ups are starting to build the tools
items.summary:
There are growing calls for Washington and Beijing to agree to slow down development of artificial intelligence. But even if they wanted to do so, how could they verify that the other side would do the same?

items.title: NVIDIA Smooth Motion Now Runs on RTX 30 Series GPUs Thanks to NVSmooth30 Mod, RTX 3050 Laptop and RTX 3080 Confirmed Working
items.summary: NVIDIA's latest frame generation technologies continue to make their way onto older RTX GPUs thanks to the modding community. This time, developer Adeline released NVSmooth30, an experimental compatibility mod that enables NVIDIA Smooth Motion on GeForce RTX 30 Series graphics cards, which the feature officially doesn't support.
